patch_description: This crossover keeps the baseline’s direct-demand signal dominant and retains the current implementation’s activity-aware endpoint and transit estimates. It reduces the indirect reward substantially: each OD pair’s two-hop reward is split across eligible intermediates, so alternative paths do not each receive the full demand reward. The quadratic terms remain limited to two-hop paths (at most \(n(n-1)(n-2)\)), and the evaluator’s degree penalty is left untouched.
